description: This file defines the DeviceModelCatalog utility in Swift for managing and presenting device information based on model identifiers and device families, including loading mapping resources and providing symbol and presentation information.

classes.name: DeviceModelCatalog
classes.description: A utility enum for categorizing device models, loading device identifiers mapping, and providing presentation details.

methods.name: presentation
methods.description: Returns a DevicePresentation object containing a device title and symbol based on device family and model identifier.

methods.name: symbol
methods.description: Determines the symbol name for a device based on device family, model identifier, and friendly name.

methods.name: symbolFor
methods.description: Derives a symbol for a device model identifier, returning specific symbols for recognized prefixes.

methods.name: fallbackSymbol
methods.description: Provides a generic fallback symbol based on the device family when specific mapping isn't available.

methods.name: loadModelIdentifierToName
methods.description: Loads and merges device identifier to name mappings from external JSON resources.

methods.name: loadMapping
methods.description: Loads a mapping dictionary from a resource JSON file.

methods.name: locateResourceBundle
methods.description: Attempts to locate the resource bundle containing device identifier mappings.

methods.name: bundleIfContainsDeviceModels
methods.description: Checks if a bundle contains device model JSON resources and returns the bundle if so.

methods.name: NameValue (enum)
methods.description: A decoder enum to handle JSON data that can be either a string or an array of strings, used for parsing device name mappings.
